supplements.title: The effect of moderate physical activity on NK cells populations and cytotoxic T lymphocytes in young, healthy women.
supplements.summary: Moderate physical activity boosts cancer-fighting immune cells in young women, strengthening the body's natural defense against disease.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective Potential of Pinostrobin in a Rat Model of Huntington's Disease: Behavioural, Biochemical, and Molecular Docking Evidence.
supplements.summary: Pinostrobin, a natural compound, protected rats from Huntington's-like brain damage by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Bioactivity-guided metabolomics reveals discriminant cytotoxic signatures in Siparuna guianensis.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified toxic compounds in a plant species that could lead to safer, more selective cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Cholesterol as a metabolic integrator of oncogenic signaling, immune evasion, and therapy resistance.
supplements.summary: Cholesterol fuels tumor growth and immune evasion; targeting cholesterol metabolism may restore cancer treatment sensitivity.

supplements.title: Punica Granatum Seed Oil Mitigates Aflatoxin B1-induced Oxidative Stress and Caspase-associated Apoptosis in HepG2 Cells.
supplements.summary: Pomegranate seed oil reduces cancer cell damage and death triggered by aflatoxin B1, a hepatocellular carcinoma risk factor.

supplements.title: DIA-based proteomic analysis reveals Scutellaria barbata D. Don Exosome-like nanovesicles promote ferroptosis in HCC through Nrf2/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway.
supplements.summary: Plant-derived nanovesicles from Scutellaria barbata trigger ferroptosis in liver cancer cells by disabling a protective cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Label-free cell phenotypic profiling of sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor 1 and discovery of its agonist from natural products.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered corylin, a natural compound, as a novel S1PR1 agonist with potential therapeutic applications for autoimmune diseases and cancer.

supplements.title: Cannabidiol enhances tamoxifen efficacy via CREB-mediated suppression of ERα signaling in ER-positive breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Cannabidiol boosts breast cancer drug tamoxifen effectiveness by suppressing estrogen receptor signaling in resistant cancer cells.

supplements.title: Licoisoflavone A potentiates oxaliplatin efficacy in colorectal cancer by dual targeting arginine metabolism of tumor microenvironment and cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Licoisoflavone A combined with oxaliplatin improves colorectal cancer treatment by targeting arginine metabolism in both tumor and immune cells.

supplements.title: Vitamin D deficiency and pain severity in endometriosis: a phenotype-based retrospective observational study.
supplements.summary: Low vitamin D levels are linked to worse pain in women with endometriosis, particularly in deep infiltrating cases.

supplements.title: Solubility-improved and antitumor activity of (-)-cannabidiol conjugates.
supplements.summary: Scientists improved cannabidiol's effectiveness against tumors by making it more soluble in water, overcoming a major limitation of the natural compound.

supplements.title: Polymerized Polyphenol-Decorated Cationic Hydroxyethylcellulose Nanocomplexes for Enhanced Breast Cancer Cell Killing Effects.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining drug and gene therapy to kill breast cancer cells more effectively, even in drug-resistant cases.

supplements.title: Polyclonal antibodies and probiotics improve immune dysfunction in a mouse model of inflammatory bowel disease.
supplements.summary: Probiotics and polyclonal antibodies together effectively reduce inflammation and improve immune function in mice with inflammatory bowel disease.

supplements.title: An in-depth analysis of the molecular changes induced by short-term calorie restriction before living kidney donation.
supplements.summary: Short-term calorie restriction before kidney donation is safe and activates protective molecular changes through reduced inflammation and insulin signaling.

supplements.title: Nutritional Intervention Trials in Linxian China- Continued Follow-up
supplements.summary: Beta-carotene, vitamin E, and selenium reduced stomach cancer and total mortality in a high-risk Chinese population.

off_label.title: Alcohol-Induced Metabolic Stress Sensed by m6A-Modified ChREBP Drives Immune Evasion in Esophageal Carcinogenesis.
off_label.summary: Alcohol-induced changes to a protein called ChREBP help esophageal cancer cells evade the immune system, and blocking this process could prevent or treat the disease.

off_label.title: A STAT1/ETC/GBP1 axis represents a potential therapeutic target for noncommunicable granulomatous skin disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified that blocking a metabolic pathway and protein called GBP1 can reduce granuloma formation in skin diseases, suggesting metformin as a potential treatment.

off_label.title: EZH2 inhibition via GSK-126 mitigates EndMT and atherosclerosis in diabetes: A translational epigenetic approach.
off_label.summary: GSK-126 drug blocks EZH2 protein to reduce atherosclerosis and vessel damage in diabetic patients.

off_label.title: The Use of Ketamine for Depression in Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review of Efficacy, Safety, and Clinical Applications.
off_label.summary: Ketamine rapidly relieves depression in cancer patients within hours to days, offering a promising alternative to traditional antidepressants.

off_label.title: Cholesterol as a metabolic integrator of oncogenic signaling, immune evasion, and therapy resistance.
off_label.summary: Cholesterol fuels tumor growth and immune evasion; targeting cholesterol metabolism may restore cancer treatment sensitivity.

off_label.title: Metformin versus DPP-4 inhibitors and risk of parkinsonism in type 2 diabetes: an active-comparator cohort study with a landmark design.
off_label.summary: Metformin use in type 2 diabetes patients may reduce Parkinson's disease risk compared to DPP-4 inhibitors.

off_label.title: Effects of metformin on head and neck cancer: an umbrella review.
off_label.summary: Metformin's effectiveness against head and neck cancer remains unclear despite showing promise in other cancer types.

off_label.title: Causal relationship between aspirin use and age-related macular degeneration.
off_label.summary: Aspirin use may genetically increase the risk of age-related macular degeneration, a common eye disease affecting older adults.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis vulnerability of enzalutamide resistant prostate cancer conferred by ACSL4 overexpression and GPX4 antagonism.
off_label.summary: Enzalutamide-resistant prostate cancer becomes vulnerable to ferroptosis when GPX4 is blocked, offering a new treatment approach using the drug Auranofin.

off_label.title: Development of metformin-encapsulated poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid)-polyethylene glycol nanoparticles.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles carrying metformin to treat thyroid cancer with potentially fewer side effects than conventional therapies.

off_label.title: Bilateral temporal arteritis with multiorgan eosinophilic infiltration treated with IL-5 targeted antibody.
off_label.summary: IL-5 antibody treatment achieved sustained remission in a patient with rare eosinophilic temporal arteritis resistant to steroids and methotrexate.

off_label.title: Epigenetic Silencing of RFX7 Defines a Transcriptional Axis Linking Lactate Metabolism to Immune Checkpoint Therapy in Glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Restoring RFX7 in glioblastoma reduces lactate production and improves immunotherapy response by suppressing immune-suppressive signals.

off_label.title: Elotuzumab enhances the anti-tumor activity of Vγ9Vδ2 T cells against primary effusion lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Elotuzumab enhances immune T cells to kill primary effusion lymphoma cells, suggesting a new combination treatment approach.

off_label.title: Biologic and targeted synthetic treatment of SAPHO syndrome: systematic literature review.
off_label.summary: SAPHO syndrome, a rare autoimmune disorder, may be effectively treated with biologic drugs used off-label, though approved therapies remain unavailable.

off_label.title: Polypharmacologic phosphoinositide modulation by FTY720 triggers endomembrane trafficking collapse and metabolic starvation in cancer cells.
off_label.summary: FTY720 kills cancer cells by disrupting nutrient transport, causing metabolic starvation even in nutrient-rich environments.

biomarkers.title: Decoding the microbiome: artificial intelligence-targeted gut microenvironment breakthroughs in personalized cancer therapy.
biomarkers.summary: AI analyzes gut microbiome data to personalize cancer therapy, improving treatment outcomes and reducing chemotherapy resistance in colorectal cancer.

biomarkers.title: Dynamic central-peripheral balance in brain-muscle interactions reveals motor impairment in post-stroke hemiplegia: an exploratory study.
biomarkers.summary: Study reveals brain-muscle communication imbalance in stroke patients may predict motor recovery and guide personalized rehabilitation strategies.

biomarkers.title: Acylglycerol kinase contributes to cell proliferation by activating NF‑κB signaling pathway in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Pancreatic cancer cells with elevated AGK protein grow faster and resist treatment by activating a key growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: Upregulation of PHLDA genes drives malignancy and therapeutic resistance in head and neck Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: PHLDA genes are overactive in head and neck cancer, driving tumor growth and treatment resistance, making them potential diagnostic markers and drug targets.

biomarkers.title: xCELLigence™ RTCA system in cancer biology: innovations in real-time functional profiling.
biomarkers.summary: Real-time cell analysis technology enables continuous, non-invasive monitoring of cancer cell behavior, improving drug testing and understanding of tumor responses.

biomarkers.title: Clinical Manifestations, Tumor Associations, and Long-Term Outcomes of Anti-KLHL11 Encephalitis.
biomarkers.summary: Anti-KLHL11 encephalitis, a newly identified brain inflammation linked to testicular cancer in men, requires better understanding of symptoms and treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Ferroptosis in colorectal cancer: Molecular mechanisms and regulatory crosstalk with therapeutic prospects (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Inducing ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death process, shows promise for treating colorectal cancer and overcoming drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: FOSL2 drives transcriptional activation of super‑enhancer-regulated DYNC1H1 to promote hypoxia‑induced oral squamous cell carcinoma progression.
biomarkers.summary: In oral cancer, the FOSL2 protein activates DYNC1H1 gene expression under low-oxygen conditions, driving tumor growth and spread.

biomarkers.title: Advances in Kruppel‑like factor 5 as a transcription factor and its role in gynecological tumors (Review).
biomarkers.summary: KLF5, a transcription factor, drives gynecological tumor progression and represents a potential therapeutic target for cervical, ovarian, and endometrial cancers.

biomarkers.title: P2X7 receptor: An emerging therapeutic target in acute myeloid leukemia (Review).
biomarkers.summary: P2X7 receptor, overexpressed in acute myeloid leukemia, is an emerging drug target that promotes cancer cell survival and immune suppression.

biomarkers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Oncology: Clinical Applications, Challenges, and Opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: AI systems combining imaging, pathology, and genetic data improve cancer diagnosis, risk assessment, and treatment selection across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Through the Spectrum: Frontline Therapy, Sequencing With Subsequent Therapy, and Treatment of Double-Refractory Patients.
biomarkers.summary: Multiple new drug combinations now treat chronic lymphocytic leukemia at different disease stages, though options remain limited for resistant patients.

biomarkers.title: Updates on Management of Anal Cancer: A New Era Has Begun.
biomarkers.summary: Immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy improves outcomes for metastatic anal cancer, while chemoradiotherapy remains standard for early-stage disease.

biomarkers.title: Measurable Residual Disease in Pediatric Acute Leukemia: Application and Interpretation of Current and Emerging Methodologies.
biomarkers.summary: Monitoring residual leukemia cells during pediatric acute leukemia treatment predicts outcomes and guides personalized therapy intensity.

biomarkers.title: Navigating Treatment Decisions in Early-Stage Hormone Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Genomic assays help personalize treatment decisions in early-stage hormone receptor-positive breast cancer by identifying patients who benefit most from chemotherapy.

trials.title: Clinical Manifestations, Tumor Associations, and Long-Term Outcomes of Anti-KLHL11 Encephalitis.
trials.summary: Anti-KLHL11 encephalitis, a newly identified brain inflammation linked to testicular cancer in men, requires better understanding of symptoms and treatment outcomes.

trials.summary: Genomic assays help personalize treatment decisions in early-stage hormone receptor-positive breast cancer by identifying patients who benefit most from chemotherapy.

trials.title: High-Risk Multiple Myeloma: Redefining Risk and Rethinking Therapy.
trials.summary: High-risk multiple myeloma remains deadly despite advances; researchers propose better identification methods and personalized treatments to improve survival outcomes.

trials.title: Novel Synthetic Lethal Therapeutic Strategies in Precision Oncology.
trials.summary: Synthetic lethal therapy targets genetic weaknesses in cancer cells, offering new treatment options for previously hard-to-treat tumors.

trials.title: Conformation-sensitive nanobody immunoassay enables differentiation of live and heat-inactivated Salmonella Typhimurium for food safety monitoring.
trials.summary: A new nanobody-based test quickly detects dead Salmonella Typhimurium in food, verifying if cooking has successfully killed bacteria.

trials.title: Risk stratification in pediatric dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumors: impact of molecular alterations, age, and extent of surgery.
trials.summary: Researchers identified that FGFR1 mutations, younger age, and incomplete surgery predict which children's brain tumors will progress.

trials.title: Development and Application of an LC-MS/MS Assay for Plasma Propofol Quantification in Major Noncardiac Surgical Patients to Evaluate Target-Controlled Infusion Algorithms.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new laboratory test to measure propofol levels in blood, enabling better dosing algorithms for this common surgical anesthetic.

trials.title: Evaluating Oncologists' Communication Strategies Regarding Molecular Testing and Immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Oncologists often use unclear language when discussing genetic testing and immunotherapy for colorectal cancer, limiting patient understanding.

trials.title: Patient- and Physician-Identified Considerations for Clinical Implementation of a New Risk-Based Prediction Tool to Guide Surveillance Mammography in Breast Cancer Survivors.
trials.summary: Researchers identified patient and doctor concerns about using a new tool to predict second breast cancer risk and guide mammography screening decisions.

trials.title: The Use of Non-Contrast Abbreviated MRI for the Detection of Recurrent Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Postoperativ Surveillance.
trials.summary: A faster, simpler MRI method effectively detects recurring hepatocellular carcinoma after surgery, improving patient monitoring accessibility.

trials.title: The Use of Ketamine for Depression in Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review of Efficacy, Safety, and Clinical Applications.
